name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.179: The Download tab showed FOUR "methods" where the operator expects one. Three
    h4 sections - Auto-sync, Anchor-sync, Drift check - each described the same job and each
    carried its own essay, so a single mechanism read as four. They are now ONE section,
    "Subtitle correction (to the audio)", with ONE short intro and all five switches beneath it.
    Two of the old texts also contradicted the code: "one whose offset moves, which the audio
    sync above cannot correct" and "has no valid single correction" - both false since the
    staircase landed in .178, and both green in the test, because T114 only checked LENGTH
    (300 chars) and a banned-vocabulary list. "cannot correct" is 46 characters and carries no
    number, so a false sentence hid behind being short. T114 now matches the refuted claims
    across the intros, the descriptions AND the switch labels - a planted "never shifted" label
    fails only with the label scope included. Six faults planted, six caught.
    The drift check's reject is also documented where it acts: it consumes that gate's verdict,
    so without the drift check switched on the reject does nothing.
